summary: This stage executed an exceptionally thorough static audit of the Paper P paper and repository at commit 6392702. The agent demonstrated that the repository cannot run end-to-end because 43 of 45 referenced path literals (including all embeddings) are absent, code for word similarity, translation P@k, and Spearman correlation is completely missing, and several pipeline variables are undefined. It uncovered major implementation discrepancies including the use of LinearSVC instead of the claimed LDA (tracing the reported 0.389 cosine to SVM coefficients), an operator-precedence bug in doPCA centering, unnormalized dot-product MWEAT, non-nouns in training lists, and shifting definitional pairs during mitigation. It traced and reproduced one Table 2 row from saved notebook outputs while proving Table 1 is largely untraceable, maintaining rigorous calibration and avoiding overreaching claims throughout.
